segments.oily: One reviewer with oily skin reports the cream broke her out, though she kept the jar for a family member it worked well for; another reviewer confirms the moisturizer does not make her skin oily.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, including one with dry, thin skin in a very dry climate, report it feels plumping and hydrating without heaviness, and one notes it does not aggravate her rosacea.
segments.sensitive: Most sensitive-skin reviewers report no irritation, stinging, or breakouts and specifically value the fragrance-free formula, though one reviewer cautions that the cream can feel slightly greasy and would not recommend it for sensitive, breakout-prone skin.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their 30s through 70s report firmer skin, softened fine lines, and fewer wrinkles with regular use, with several longtime users in their 50s-70s crediting the product with visibly younger-looking skin over years of use.

concerns.aging: Reviewers across a wide age range report firmer, smoother skin and reduced fine lines and wrinkles with consistent use, including several long-term users in their 50s to 70s who credit the cream with visibly younger-looking skin over years.
concerns.dehydration: Reviewers consistently report the cream hydrates well, leaving skin plump and soft without heaviness, including reviewers with dry skin in dry climates.
concerns.barrier: Most reviewers, including some with sensitive skin or rosacea, report no irritation or stinging; one reviewer, however, developed itching within minutes and pimples and bumps over the following days, noting the fragranced version of the same product had not caused this reaction for her.
concerns.blemishes: Reviewers are mostly positive, with several noting the cream does not cause breakouts even when other creams have; two reviewers, one with oily skin, report the cream broke them out, and one reviewer specifically cautions it may not suit sensitive, breakout-prone skin due to its slight grease.
concerns.oiliness: Most reviewers report the cream is not oily or greasy despite its rich feel and works well under makeup, though one reviewer describes it as slightly greasy and one with oily skin reports it broke her out.

extraits.texte: Had previously used the fragranced version of this Olay, worked very well but found the smell too strong. Ordered this fragrance free version from Amazon and it arrived quickly and the LOT number on the box shows it was just produced 2 months ago. The texture of the cream in the jar is really thick and waxy with a chemical smell...the consistency of the fragranced version was more "luxurious"....like the non-fragranced Retinol 24 that I still have. Applied the moisturizer...it felt heavy and lit it was not absorbing...within 5 minutes my face was itching and over the next several days, I developed pimples and bumps. The fragranced version did not cause this. Maybe something has changed? Amazon will not take it back...so you will be taking your chances buying here....even if product is defective or has changed. Good luck!

extraits.titre: Hydrating, Firming & Perfect for Sensitive Skin!
extraits.texte: I recently started using Olay Regenerist Micro-Sculpting Cream (Fragrance-Free), and it has quickly become a staple in my skincare routine! If you’re looking for a luxurious, effective moisturizer without any added scent, this one delivers on all fronts. 💧 Deep Hydration: This cream absorbs beautifully and keeps my skin feeling soft and moisturized all day — even in cooler or drier weather. It doesn’t sit heavy or greasy, but still locks in moisture. ✨ Improves Firmness & Texture: After consistent use, I’ve noticed my skin looks firmer and more lifted. Fine lines seem softer, and my overall complexion feels smoother and more resilient. 🌿 Fragrance-Free & Gentle: Since this version is fragrance-free, it’s perfect for sensitive skin or anyone who prefers minimal fragrance in their products. No irritation, no stinging — just soothing hydration. 🧴 Great Base for Makeup: This cream works wonderfully under makeup. It keeps skin smooth without pilling or interfering with foundation or concealer. 💆‍♀️ Rich Yet Lightweight: It’s rich enough to feel deeply nourishing but lightweight enough to wear day or night. I use it morning and evening — it’s that versatile. Overall, Olay Regenerist Micro-Sculpting Cream (Fragrance-Free) is a fantastic moisturizer that hydrates, firms, and feels great on the skin. Highly recommend for anyone seeking effective, everyday anti-aging care! 🌟💧✨
